content: Industrial processing turns raw nexus ore into technology. The chain is fixed:
Ore -> Crusher -> Nexus Dust -> Processor -> Refined Nexus -> Plates and Components.
Each machine is a kinetic consumer with real demands. The Crusher wants 120 RPM and 20 Nm; the Processor wants 240 RPM and 15 Nm — you cannot run it straight off a generator.
Watch the machine status: RUNNING, IDLE, NO POWER, BROWNOUT, BLOCKED. A blocked output means the machine is waiting on you, not on power.
title: Industrial Processing
